summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the related changes, but nothing has been run. Changes: rich/progress.py (new column between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn; Task.finished_time field; finished now means a finished time is present; capture in update and advance inside the lock; clears in Task._reset and Progress.reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports and TYPE_CHECKING-only Table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry); tests/test_progress.py (new unit test, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns, and its expected output regenerated by hand from a clock-read trace); tests/test_palette.py (new, 16-row check). Checks done by reading and grep only: row cell counts (12 rows, 86 style resets, matching the spec's one-extra-cell-per-row rule) and bar widths (25 start frames, 16 finished frames). Not verified: the expected output of test_columns is derived by hand and has not been executed, so it is the first thing to check when the suite runs. No commits were made.
